name: mxgmn/WaveFunctionCollapse
description: The original Wave Function Collapse algorithm generating bitmap and tilemap output from a single example image, drawing on ideas from quantum mechanics. Widely used in commercial games including Bad North, Caves of Qud, and Townscaper; ported to every major language and engine.
score_rationale: The canonical WFC implementation with massive community adoption and ports to C++, Rust, Unity, Godot, and Unreal.
summary: Canonical WFC algorithm for procedural tile/bitmap generation widely adopted in commercial games.
